documents.text: The City Library lets members borrow up to 10 books at a time for a period of 21 days. Books can be renewed online two times, unless another member has reserved them. A late fee of $0.25 per day is charged for each overdue book, and the fee stops growing once it reaches $10. Members who lose a book must pay its replacement cost plus a $5 processing fee. Membership is free for residents of the city, while visitors pay $15 per year for a card. DVDs can be borrowed for 7 days only.

The main library is open Monday to Thursday from 8 AM to 8 PM, and on Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM. On Saturdays the library opens at 10 AM and closes at 4 PM, and it is closed on Sundays and public holidays. Study rooms can be reserved up to 14 days in advance for a maximum of 3 hours per day. Each study room fits up to 6 people and has a whiteboard. Group reservations need a library card from at least one member. Printing costs $0.10 per page in black and white and $0.50 per page in color. Free wifi is available in the whole building.

The library runs a children's story hour every Wednesday at 4 PM in the reading corner. It is free and suitable for ages 3 to 7. The summer reading challenge starts on June 1 and ends on August 31, and children who read 12 books receive a free ticket to the science museum. Adult book clubs meet on the last Thursday of each month, and the next book is announced two weeks before. The library also offers a free computer class for seniors on Tuesday mornings at 10 AM. Registration for all events is done at the front desk or on the library website.

queries.query: How many books can I take out at once?
queries.reference_answer: Up to 10 books at a time.
